text:
Before Returning to the Future! New story this September.
Before heading back, Jon wants to do something very special with Clark Kent... what could it be?
I don't know how I'd react if Julius Novachrono were in front of me. What would you do? 😮
Another Naruto character! The mighty Gaara 🔥
Shanks just wants to relax with a massage, but he wasn't expecting to get tickled.
Jin Kazama from Tekken throwing a kick. I wouldn't mind taking that one 😄
Yoichi Isagi after an intense training session. This is an older piece from a few years ago 😁
So far, these are the only times we've seen Sasaki's feet in the anime. They're really well detailed ❤️
In my head, this what Cell's feet actually look like. We've only been seeing his shoes this whole time.
It's finally Friday! Time for Tsukishima Kei to get some love too 😊
While we work on this month's story, I hope you enjoyed Nagi's Decision as much as Reo and Isagi did ❤️
